# Changelog

## 0.1.0 — Unreleased

- Independent momentum label spacing through `momentum.label-offset` (default 0.20 canvas units).

- CeTZ drawing API with inferred or explicit vertices.
- Scalar, fermion, photon, gluon, ghost and double propagator presets.
- Vertex markers, style registration, labels and independent momentum arrows.
- Automatic layout, main-line constraints, parallel edges and self-loops.
- Local gaps at arrowless photon crossings.
- English A4 user guide and API reference generated with tidy.
